generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
General conditions as per bid document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one similar nature work of value not less than Rs 15.00 Lakhs (including GST) in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22 , 2022-23 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level).

The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in atleast two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover of Rs. 30.00 Lakhs (including GST) during the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) The bidder shall submit certified copy of the turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level).

Providing, installing, configuring, and commissioning a licensed Record Room Management Software with comprehensive search and retrieval capabilities, including full-text search and document retrieval features.
